review: This browser specification owns bounded MS07 Workspace filter layout, MS08 current-page task grouping/scope and MS09 public-form presentation regression contracts using the canonical fixture boundary. This change only adds observable keyboard focus prerequisites to the existing MS08 phone case; it adds no fixtures, queries, authority, application behavior, helper abstraction or scenario responsibility. Assertions stay next to their keypresses to expose the expected focus handoffs. Only the two new aria-expanded inspections include a background trigger hidden by the canonical modal Select; visible option focus and all original trigger and result checks remain. Other test cases and original action/outcome statements are byte-preserved. A module split would be unrelated churn for this synchronization repair.
